question_set: the 15 questions whose source passage hybrid RAG retrieved in its top 6 and CVT-RAG did not (runs/retrieval_eval.json)
method: re-ran CVT-RAG retrieval on these questions (live release 3, read-only) with the 3-passages-per-document cap removed (max_per_doc=99), and separately with population demotion disabled (population_threshold=-1)
note: in all 14, the source document already filled 3 of CVT-RAG's 6 slots and the source passage would have been its 4th
